descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S04 「Quick Dictation 和 p72 原型的分格系统一致」 Quick Dictation matches the p72 prototype's compartment system

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T1 The build matches the source-of-truth prototype's compartment system (RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html, attached to the ticket).（TFA-92582 AC 1）

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html (ticket attachment) and the local build

When Compare side by side: entry point on the list, full-screen pad, box layout, room chip, 'Matches on your list', Assign / Re-assign, picker, 'New compartment', the 'Nothing is auto-merged' note, delete control, Dictate / Stop

Then Same compartment system: one box per patient, placed only by a tap, nothing auto-merged

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Human side-by-side review against the prototype, each difference listed. Delete control and cross-device pad are Q12

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S04 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-04.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）（VISUAL (pad states vs p72 side by side)）；辅助：STATIC · 静态检查（构建产物 / 扫描） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
